title: Agents take a bigger slice of all HN stories
question: Does the word agent or agents appear in a larger share of story titles in the latest 12 months than before?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: The word agent or agents appears in a larger share of all story titles in the latest 12 months than it did before.
expect: If true, the share of all stories whose title names agents should be at least 3x higher in the latest 12 months than in all earlier stories since 2006 (pooled) (1.5x is weak, 1x or lower refutes it).
thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h301, written before this card was run. h301 is left unchanged.
caveats: The word "agent" also names software agents, real estate agents and secret agents, so some matches are not about AI.
Title words only: stories about agents that never say so in the title are missed.
The latest 12 months stop at the last full month in the film file, not today.
